author: squirrel.35008284
title: Looking for artist for novel character art no AI
content: 🎨 Calling all artists! I’m planning to self-publish my novel within the next year and I’m looking for an artist to create character art for my two main characters. ✨ One important requirement: NO AI art or AI tools used at any stage of the process. I had a bad experience earlier this year with someone who claimed their work was fully human-made, only to discover otherwise after paying. I want to work with a real artist and support genuine creativity, and I’m happy to pay fairly for your work!

author: auroracratebookbox
title: Looking for artists with availability to end of 2026
content: We’re looking for some artists with availability between now and the end of 2026. Self recs welcome, please include price list + some examples. No dms please. Also to clarify, NO AI - human artists only please.

author: sega_jenesis_
title: Commissioning artist for custom Pokémon binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰
